IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: DEDICATED TO IMPROVING LIVES THROUGHOUT THE GREATER SAN DIEGO AND BAJA COMMUNITY.
IRS990.MissionDesc: THE SAN DIEGO PADRES FOUNDATION IS DEDICATED TO IMPROVING LIVES THROUGHOUT THE GREATER SAN DIEGO AND BAJA COMMUNITY BY WORKING HAND-IN-HAND WITH ORGANIZATIONS THAT SHARE OUR VISION.
IRS990.Desc: IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE SAN DIEGO PADRES, THE PADRES FOUNDATION RUNS YOUTH BASEBALL CAMPS. NET PROCEEDS FROM THE BASEBALL CAMPS DIRECTLY BENEFIT THE FOUNDATION. IN 2024, THERE WERE 1,872 PARTICIPANTS ENROLLED IN THE BASEBALL CAMPS.EVERY YEAR, THE SAN DIEGO PADRES AND THE PADRES FOUNDATION ALSO PARTNER TOGETHER TO PUT ON FAN FEST. THE FOUNDATION CONDUCTS A GARAGE SALE OF UNIQUE BASEBALL MEMORABILIA AND EQUIPMENT. ALL PROCEEDS COLLECTED DIRECTLY BENEFIT THE FOUNDATION.THE SAN DIEGO PADRES, IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE PADRES FOUNDATION HAVE A FUNDRAISING EVENT WITH A SEATED DINNER WITH TABLES HOSTED BY PLAYERS, COACHES, TEAM EXECUTIVES AND ALUMNI, A COCKTAIL HOUR, LIVE ENTERTAINMENT WITH HEADLINING TALENT AND A LIVE AUCTION WITH THE OPPORTUNITY TO BID ON UNIQUE, ONE-OF-A KIND ITEMS. NET PROCEEDS GO TO THE PADRES FOUNDATION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FOUNDATION IS EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL TAXES UNDER SECTION 501(C)(3) OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE AND ONLY UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME IS SUBJECT TO FEDERAL AND STATE INCOME TAX. THE FOUNDATION IS A PUBLIC, CHARITABLE ORGANIZATION, AND CONTRIBUTIONS TO THE FOUNDATION QUALIFY FOR A CHARITABLE TAX DEDUCTION TO DONORS. THE FOUNDATION FILES INFORMATION RETURNS IN THE U.S. FEDERAL JURISDICTION AND THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA. UNCERTAIN TAX PROVISIONS, IF ANY, ARE RECORDED WITH THE FINANCIAL ACCOUNTING STANDARDS BOARD (FASB) ACCOUNTING STANDARDS CODIFICATION (ASC) 740, INCOME TAXES (PREVIOUSLY FASB INTERPRETATION NO. 48). FASB ASC 740 REQUIRES THE RECOGNITION OF A LIABILITY FOR A TAX POSITION THAT DOES NOT MEET THE MORE LIKELY THAN NOT STANDARD THAT THE POSITION WILL BE SUSTAINED UPON EXAMINATION BY THE TAXING AUTHORITIES. THERE WAS NO LIABILITY FOR UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS RECORDED AT DECEMBER 31, 2024 AND 2023.
